sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Terradets is a Catalan limestone gorge destination north of Lleida.

sections.heading: History and context
warnings: No sourced history and context content found for this pass.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: Climb Europe supports a limestone gorge with the 500 m Paret de les Bagasses buttress; legacy evidence adds hard sport climbing at Paret de les Bruixes and multipitch routes.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: Legacy evidence says Terradets is known for hard sport climbing but also has easier grades and quality multipitch routes.

sections.heading: Season and conditions
sections.body: Legacy evidence supports late autumn and winter for Les Bruixes, plus autumn and spring for Bruixes Norte and Paret de les Bagasses.
